region_scene_page.compact: This road follows bands that made older post-punk moves feel new inside the blog/indie era: sharp guitars, cool surfaces, and rhythm you can dance to.
region_scene_page.standard: This road follows bands that made older post-punk moves feel new inside the blog/indie era: sharp guitars, cool surfaces, and rhythm you can dance to. region_scene_page.deep: This road follows bands that made older post-punk moves feel new inside the blog/indie era: sharp guitars, cool surfaces, and rhythm you can dance to. The distinction is angularity and mood: darker, more bass-driven, and more mannered than simple garage rock revival. Interpol's PDA, Bloc Party's Like Eating Glass, Yeah Yeah Yeahs' Date with the Night, and Franz Ferdinand's Take Me Out give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
